hints.title: Streak Precomputation
hints.text: For each index, precompute the length of the non-increasing sequence ending at it, and the length of the non-decreasing sequence starting at it.

hints.title: Bidirectional Passes
hints.text: Compute left[i] from 1 to n - 1 indicating non-increasing run length up to i. Compute right[i] from n - 2 down to 0 indicating non-decreasing run length from i.

hints.title: Good Index Condition
hints.text: An index i is good if k <= i < n - k and left[i - 1] >= k and right[i + 1] >= k.

hints.title: Bidirectional Streak Validation Implementation

complexity.notes: Two precomputation passes and one verification pass.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning k elements left and right per index takes O(n * k) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix and suffix streak arrays provide O(1) condition checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Precomputes monotonic streaks in forward and backward passes.
